HoneyGrove_Text_Npc0.en: ILLUMISE and VOLBEAT dance together\nat night.
HoneyGrove_Text_Npc0.fr: LUMIVOLE et MUCIOLE dansent\nensemble la nuit.

HoneyGrove_Text_Npc1.en: Mind the stingers. The honey is\nworth it.
HoneyGrove_Text_Npc1.fr: Attention aux dards. Le miel en\nvaut la peine.

HoneyGrove_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: I got stung twice. Two ANTIDOTEs\nfor a SILVER POWDER?
HoneyGrove_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Je me suis fait piquer deux fois.\nDeux ANTIDOTES contre de la POUDRE\lARGENT ?

HoneyGrove_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
HoneyGrove_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

HoneyGrove_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

HoneyGrove_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

HoneyGrove_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
HoneyGrove_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Y a un truc qui brille ici, mais\nton SAC est plein.
